Transport Documents

Avviso di Transito

A formal notification issued by the carrier or freight forwarder informing stakeholders of the progress, movement, or arrival of goods in transit between locations.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Avviso di Transito?

In this glossary, Avviso di Transito refers to: A formal notification issued by the carrier or freight forwarder informing stakeholders of the progress, movement, or arrival of goods in transit between locations.

How is Avviso di Transito used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "L'Avviso di Transito deve essere emesso a tutte le parti quando la merce attraversa confini internazionali o cambia modalità di trasporto."

Why does Avviso di Transito matter in logistics?

Avviso di Transito matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Avviso di Transito?

Avviso di Transito is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Avviso di Transito belong to?

In this glossary, Avviso di Transito is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A formal notification issued by the carrier or freight forwarder informing stakeholders of the progress, movement, or arrival of goods in transit between locations.

Operational example

Transit Advice must be issued to all parties when the cargo crosses international borders or changes transport mode.

Localized term

Avviso di Transito

Localized example

L'Avviso di Transito deve essere emesso a tutte le parti quando la merce attraversa confini internazionali o cambia modalità di trasporto.
